mainEntity.name: What can go wrong with a small drywall repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: The main risks are cracking again, visible seams, paint flashing, and hidden moisture problems. If the wall is damaged by a leak, the source needs to be fixed first, or the repair may fail and the damage may return.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest problems are poor blending, repeat cracking, and repairs over active moisture. If there’s any water damage, fix the cause first or the patch may not last.
